news.title: “Local and Overseas Jobs Fair 2026”
news.summary: The Public Employment Service Office (PESO) – Bayawan, under the City Cooperative & Manpower Development Office and the ICT Office, invites jobseekers to the Local and Overseas Jobs Fair on June 25, 2026 at the Puregold Main Atrium, Bayawan City.

news.title: Empowering Innovation, Inspiring Futures: 3rd iBayaw ICT Month 2026
news.summary: The City of Bayawan celebrates the 3rd iBayaw ICT Month in June 2026 — a month-long showcase of technology, innovation, and digital empowerment, highlighted by the iBayaw Robotics Competition and the Local and Overseas Jobs Fair.

news.title: D Bookshop — Bayawan’s Newest Bookstore
news.summary: Located along the National Highway in Brgy. Malabugas, D Bookshop was founded by local writer Dara Tumaca-Ramos and welcomes bibliophiles with a curated selection of books in a cozy, community-centered space.
